shortDescription: Retrieve all tasks and show their progress and details.

options.name: auto_publish_session
options.description: Publish the current session if changes have been performed after task completes.

options.name: details_level
options.description: The level of detail for some of the fields in the response can vary from showing only the UID value of the object to a fully detailed representation of the object.

options.name: from_date
options.description: The date from which tracking tasks is to be performed, by the task's last update date. ISO 8601. If timezone isn't specified in the input, the Management server's timezone is used.

options.name: initiator
options.description: Initiator's name. If name isn't specified, tasks from all initiators will be shown.

options.name: limit
options.description: The maximal number of returned results.

options.name: offset
options.description: Number of the results to initially skip.

options.name: order
options.description: Sorts results by the given field. By default the results are sorted in the descending order by the task's last update date.

options.name: to_date
options.description: The date until which tracking tasks is to be performed, by the task's last update date. ISO 8601. If timezone isn't specified in the input, the Management server's timezone is used.

options.name: version
options.description: Version of checkpoint. If not given one, the latest version taken.

options.name: wait_for_task
options.description: Wait for the task to end. Such as publish task.

options.name: wait_for_task_timeout
options.description: How many minutes to wait until throwing a timeout error.
